major_cooldowns.name: Voidblade
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Hold Voidblade until you are about to enter Void Metamorphosis, then use it right before you enter to set up your first Reaper's Toll.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table also lists id 1245414 with the same name and 5/5 parse coverage; 1245412 is the id the guide's Voidblade and smuggling discussion tracks.

major_cooldowns.name: Pierce the Veil
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast this as soon as it is off cooldown during your Void Metamorphosis window, it is your Voidblade upgraded by the form.

major_cooldowns.name: Predator's Wake
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire this off during Void Metamorphosis whenever it is up, it is your Hunt upgraded by the form and it powers your melee combo.

major_cooldowns.name: The Hunt
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Save it before pull to smuggle into your first Void Metamorphosis, then use it on cooldown afterward and only smuggle it again when it happens to line up with your next Meta window.

major_cooldowns.name: Soul Immolation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Keep it active whenever you are outside Void Metamorphosis, wait a GCD or two after it fades before reapplying, and never cast it while inside Void Metamorphosis.

defensives.name: Blur
defensives.usage_rule: Use it when you need to survive a burst of melee damage; it reduces damage taken and boosts dodge chance for its duration.
defensives.id_note: Not named in the rotation-cooldowns guide (which covers no defensives for this brand-new spec); confirmed available to Devourer via the Wowhead class overview page and verified against WCL gameData, base cooldown from its tooltip.

rules.description: Save Voidblade and The Hunt for Void Metamorphosis
rules.action: Hold Voidblade and The Hunt until Void Metamorphosis is ready, then smuggle them in right before you enter the form.

rules.description: Open with Soul Immolation, Void Ray, then Meta
rules.action: Apply Soul Immolation, fire off Void Ray, then enter Void Metamorphosis in that order to start the fight.

rules.description: Stop spending Reap once you hit multiple targets
rules.action: Drop Reap from your priority once you are fighting more than one target so Eradicate gets the souls instead.

rules.description: Eradicate takes over once you have 2+ targets
rules.action: Start weaving Eradicate in as soon as a second target joins the fight, it is not worth casting on a single target.

rules.description: Devour replaces Consume inside Void Metamorphosis
rules.action: Press Devour instead of Consume for your fury spender while Void Metamorphosis is active.

rules.description: Cull replaces Reap inside Void Metamorphosis
rules.action: Cast Cull instead of Reap at 4+ souls once you are inside Void Metamorphosis.
